subject.title: feat(plugins): add guard delivery and subagent review hooks

question: Should OpenClaw accept these guard-delivery and subagent-review phases as public core plugin API, and with what terminal escalation/redaction semantics?
rationale: This PR changes plugin API, tool-result delivery, subagent session state, and security guard behavior, so automation cannot choose the permanent API and policy boundary safely.

options.title: Rebase and settle the guard API
options.body: Move the contracts to current main's hook-types surface and define terminal escalation, redact behavior, and empty rewrite semantics before continuing merge review.

options.title: Narrow to one lifecycle seam
options.body: Split the subagent completion hook from protected-output filtering and land only the maintainer-approved seam with matching docs and tests.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep this unmerged until related lifecycle and protected-output issues have an approved guard-kernel direction.

recommendation.title: Rebase and settle the guard API
recommendation.body: Move the contracts to current main's hook-types surface and define terminal escalation, redact behavior, and empty rewrite semantics before continuing merge review.
